# Code of conduct

## Our standards

Be respectful, constructive, and welcoming. Focus feedback on the work, assume good intent, and
respect differing experiences and viewpoints.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, unwanted sexual attention, deliberate intimidation, and
publishing another person's private information are not acceptable.

## Enforcement

Report unacceptable behavior privately to the repository owner through their GitHub profile. Do
not use a public issue for conduct reports. The maintainer may edit or remove contributions and
temporarily or permanently restrict participation when necessary.

This policy applies in repository spaces and when someone is publicly representing the project.
